text: 据北京市住建委数据及市场机构统计，8月北京二手住宅网签总量13853套，环比7月的14037套，微降184套。并且，今年前8个月，北京二手房成交量超12万套，同比上涨约6%。（上证报）
text_en: According to Beijing Housing and Urban-Rural Development Commission data and market statistics, August second-hand home registrations in Beijing totaled 13,853 units, down 184 units from July's 14,037. In the first eight months of this year, Beijing's second-hand home transactions exceeded 120,000 units, up about 6% year-on-year. (Shanghai Securities News)
